title: VentureCore
description: The fields of venture.json a founder writes through foundation/core. Anything else, such as id, name or phase, is refused.

promise.description: What anyone can claim from this venture, in one or two sentences.

competence.description: What you do well enough that the promise can be kept.

tagline.description: The short line you keep across campaigns.

lifecycle_playbook.description: The lifecycle playbook the venture follows; it sets the evidence that clears each phase gate.
